ada: quick note  onboarding Velvet-6B (fp16 -> int8) shows BLEU drop on translation test (-4 pts) only for long sources. suspect rotary/tokenizer combo.
mike: paste diff + export flags?
ada: whoops meant ada :) eval: `bleu_fp16=36.2, bleu_int8=32.1` export: `./export --model velvet-6b --quant int8 --preset fast`
ci-bot: Export job exports/velvet6b-int8 #6012345678  2 failed, 7 passed. logs at /ci/exports/6012345678/logs
anya: common culprit: presets normalize rotary_base to 10000 and switch tokenizer normalization to NFKC. if the model used a nonstandard base or preserved ZWJ in vocab that changes token boundaries, long sequences diverge.
ada: (typo) i used the preset; didn't check metadata.
mike: check configs in artifact vs model hub. If rotary_base differs or head_order changed, that's our smoking gun. Also verify tokenizer parity for >4096 tokens.
ada: artifact config: {"rotary_base":"10000","head_order":"interleaved"} hub config: {"rotary_base":"8192","head_order":"standard"}
anya: yep. solution: re-export with `--preserve-rotary-base --preserve-head-order --tokenizer=embedded` and add exporter asserts.
mike: small numeric test suggestion: dump logits for fixed seed first 256 and 4096 tokens and compute L2 diff; if diff grows after a threshold that's KV/rotary mismap.
ada: re-running with flags now. kicking job. :rocket:
ci-bot: Rerun started: exports/velvet6b-int8-rerun (#6012345678-rerun)
ci-bot: Rerun finished: 0 failed, 9 passed  results at /ci/exports/6012345700/results
ada: rerun BLEU: fp16=36.2, int8-rerun=35.9  regression mostly closed. filing PR to add exporter e2e asserts for rotary_base and head_order and tokenizer parity test.
anya: also add a note to preset docs: destructive metadata changes should be opt-in.
mike: agreed. thanks all. :thumbsup:
